Poly-Revitalising Micro-Filler
The NCTF® 135 HA Treatment
NCTF® 135 HA is a unique anti-ageing, poly-revitalising micro-filler that smooths out wrinkles and hydrates the dermis, delivering the ingredients skin needs through a multipuncture mesotherapy injection technique.

At the heart of the treatment is hyaluronic acid combined with 59 skin-revitalising ingredients — 12 vitamins, 24 amino acids, 6 co-enzymes, 5 nucleic acids, 6 minerals, and glutathione — creating an optimal environment for fibroblasts, the dermis's major cell responsible for collagen, elastin, and hyaluronic acid production. NCTF is sterilised by double filtration and treats the face (including the periorbital area), neck, décolleté, and hands.

The Active Formula

Hyaluronic Acid

Hydrates the skin and restores lost volume.

59 Revitalising Ingredients

Vitamins, amino acids, co-enzymes, nucleic acids, minerals, and antioxidants support fibroblast function.

What It Treats
Dull or Tired Skin Wrinkles & Fine Lines Loss of Firmness Uneven Skin Texture Dehydration

What to Expect
Your Treatment Journey
01

Consultation

Your skin is assessed to confirm NCTF 135 HA is right for you, and contraindications such as pregnancy, autoimmune disease, or allergy are ruled out.

02

The Procedure

NCTF is delivered via a multilayer, multipuncture mesotherapy technique into the face, neck, décolleté, or hands — often using the Nanosoft™ micro-injector for a near-painless, standardised injection depth.

03

Aftercare

Avoid makeup for 12 hours, and avoid sun, UV, extreme temperatures, saunas, or steam rooms for at least 48 hours after injection.

04

Results Timeline

A protocol of 3 sessions spaced 3 weeks apart (6 weeks total) is recommended, with visible results possible from the very first session and 2 protocols recommended per year.

Why NCTF® 135 HA
Benefits

Improved Radiance & Hydration

Clinical studies recorded up to +144% radiance and +132% hydration on the face.

02

Reduced Wrinkles

Up to -33% wrinkle volume and -38% cheek folds recorded in clinical studies.

03

Increased Firmness & Density

Up to +103% tonicity and +39% dermal density recorded in clinical studies.

04

Near-Painless with Nanosoft™

The Nanosoft™ micro-injector offers a standardised injection depth with reduced pain and bruising risk versus a classic needle.

Who Is This For
Suitable for those seeking to improve overall skin quality — radiance, hydration, firmness, and texture — on the face, neck, décolleté, or hands, at any age from first-intention anti-ageing care to maintenance alongside other procedures.

The Visionary Behind ISAAC Luxe
Dr. Geetika Mittal Gupta
Founder and Medical Director of ISAAC Luxe / Aesthetic Physician, and award-winning cosmetologist — Dr. Geetika Mittal Gupta is one of India's most sought-after skin experts.

With over 15 years of experience in aesthetics, Dr. Geetika has built a reputation for personalised care and delivering results with minimal risk. Her clientele includes celebrities, influencers, and discerning individuals who trust her expertise.

She is a pioneer in introducing globally advanced treatments to India — from AI-integrated diagnostics and cutting-edge IV therapy to advanced body sculpting technology — setting new benchmarks in luxury dermatology.

Qualifications

MBBS from Govt. Medical College, Patiala. Post-graduation in Aesthetic Medicine from Cardiff University, UK. Diploma in Aesthetic Medicine from the American Academy of Aesthetic Medicine.

Global Expertise

Attended numerous international workshops and conferences globally. Known for blending ancient and modern scientific techniques to deliver trusted, clinically tested treatments.

Celebrity Trusted

Preferred aesthetic destination for Bollywood celebrities, fashion icons, social media influencers, and high-profile personalities across India's entertainment and fashion industry.

Three-Tier Philosophy

Unique AI-driven approach to long-term beauty built on three pillars: Treatment, Prevention, and Maintenance — ensuring lasting results and healthier skin over time.
